# Treasury Bulletin Table FCP-II Japanese Yen Positions
# Question asks: U.S. Treasury invested in Japanese Yen under "Foreign Exchange and Securities investments"
# as of March 31, 2025. Reported in millions of U.S. dollars.

# From the FCP-II Japanese Yen quarterly report, the U.S. Treasury holdings
# "Foreign exchange and securities investments" line as of March 31, 2025
# (value in millions of U.S. dollars)
usd_millions = 13921  # in millions USD
usd_amount = usd_millions * 1_000_000  # convert to actual dollars

# USD/JPY exchange rate as of March 31, 2025 (Macrotrends)
usd_to_jpy = 149.8525  # JPY per 1 USD (Macrotrends, 2025-03-31)

jpy_amount = usd_amount * usd_to_jpy
print(round(jpy_amount))
